Georgia Boot Men's Burnt Brown Romeo Work Boot
products.description:
This Georgia Giant Romeo work boot in burnt brown delivers classic style with dependable construction and all-day comfort.

Built with rich full-grain leather, this pull-on Romeo is easy to wear thanks to twin gores and sturdy pull tabs. The polyurethane Georgia Giant outsole offers solid traction and resists oil, chemicals, and slips for dependable footing on and off the job.

Goodyear® welt construction adds durability you can count on, while a steel shank and EVA midsole provide stability underfoot.
